chunks: Swear by Allah falsely and save your brother from being killed.

key_terms.أَخَاكَ: Your brother; here meaning a fellow believer or fellow human in danger
key_terms.بِاللَّهِ: By Allah; invoking Allah in an oath

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to swear a false oath in order to save someone from being killed?
ai.summary: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام instructs that preserving a believer’s life may take priority in an extreme situation, even if that involves uttering a false oath. The hadith highlights the grave sanctity of life and indicates a legal-ethical hierarchy in cases of necessity.
